snippet.title: City of Dolorosa - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
You've just died. Stand trial for the ultimate sin and discover all the secrets that lie within Dolorosa, the cruelest city in Hell.

WISHLIST NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3246880/City_of_Dolorosa/

We are Cuelebre Cult, making games from the north of Spain 🐍

Play City of Dolorosa's Demo here: https://arive.itch.io/city-of-dolorosa 🎮

You can follow our progress on Twitter (https://x.com/cuelebrecult) 🐤 and Bluesky (https://bsky.app/profile/cuelebrecult.bsky.social) 🦋

Find all of our links here: https://linktr.ee/cuelebrecult 🕸
